### Ideas {.tabset}

:::{.card title="Newest Ideas"}
- Would be useful to make the connection between $S_t^{\text{continuous}}$ and $S_m^{\text{discrete}}$. The first gives us the number of alive particles at time t, the second gives us the number of alive particles after the $m$th split. Might it be that:
$$
S_{e^{}}^{\text{continuous}} = S_m^{\text{discrete}} 
$$
Not sure about the equal to $0$ part:
$$
t - \frac{\log m}{\tilde \lambda} = 0 \implies 
t = \frac{\log m}{\tilde \lambda} \implies
\tilde \lambda t = \log m \implies
e^{\tilde \lambda t} = m 
$$
:::
